name: 3x3x3 Cubes Only in Timog 2026

venue.name: Shoppes at Victoria
venue.address: Victoria Tower, Panay Ave, Diliman, Quezon City, 1103 Metro Manila

information:
Get your cubes ready and test your speed! Join us for a full day of official 3x3x3 speedcubing action recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA) and the Philippine Cubers Association (PCA)!

🏆 FEATURED EVENTS:
3x3x3 Cube (Main Event) (Dual Rounds)
3x3x3 One-Handed (Dual Rounds)
3x3x3 Blindfolded
3x3x3 Multi-Blind 

💳 Registration Fee:
Regular Registration: ₱500 (covers all events)
On-the-Spot Registration: ₱600 (subject to slot availability on competition day)

🗓 Registration Schedule:Registration Opens: September 21, 2026

Slots are filled on a first-paid, first-served basis. Secure your spot early!

📲 Payment Details: Please refer to the Extra Registration Requirements on this WCA competition page for complete payment instructions and proof of payment submission instructions before registering.

See you all at the competition floor! 🔥
